question: Where’s the closest gallery as you move from the Dinosaur Place at Nature's Art Village, Montville, CT in the direction of Casey Farm, Saunderstown, RI?
sql: WITH start_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dinosaur Place%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Montville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1 ), end_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Casey Farm%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Saunderstown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%RI%' LIMIT 1 ), -- Calculate the target bearing (direction) from the start POI to the end POI target_direction AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS bearing_deg FROM start_poi s, end_poi e ), -- Find all galleries and calculate their bearing and distance from the start POI galleries_info AS ( SELECT p.poi_name, p.geometry, ST_Distance(sp.geometry, p.geometry)::geography AS distance_from_start, degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) AS gallery_bearing_deg FROM pois p, start_poi sp WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' ) SELECT gi.poi_name FROM galleries_info gi, target_direction td WHERE -- Filter galleries that are within +/- 45 degrees of the target bearing -- The MOD function handles the angle wrap-around (e.g., 350 degrees vs 10 degrees) ABS( MOD((gi.gallery_bearing_deg - td.bearing_deg + 540), 360) - 180 ) <= 45 -- This sets the angular tolerance (e.g., +/- 45 degrees) ORDER BY gi.distance_from_start ASC LIMIT 1;
